A '''stone viaduct''' was part of the many structures that dotted the [[Massassi Site/Legends|Massassi Site]] on the [[Yavin 4/Legends|fourth moon]] of [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin Prime]]. The end of the bridge pointed toward the site's dominating structure, the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]], and ended in a reflecting pool. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the viaduct still existed, although some of its spans had collapsed. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], which had settled its headquarters in the Great Temple, had also installed a small command post under the viaduct. During the [[Yavin blockade|Blockade of Yavin]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] [[Strike on Yavin 4|attacked]] the Massassi Site in retaliation for the destruction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] by the Alliance a few [[Standard month/Legends|months]] earlier. During the strike, the Imperials secured the viaduct, the pool and a nearby [[Massassi Water Fountain|water fountain]].
